snippet.title: The Way of the Tray — Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Way of the Tray is a waiter simulator with action puzzle elements in a Japanese spirit world setting inspired by Ghibli studio films. Your task is to master the skill of serving dishes and earn the trust of yokai patrons. Will you be able to prove yourself and find your way home, like the protagonists of the iconic anime?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373830/The_Way_of_the_Tray_Japanese_Restaurant_Simulator

🔗 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/nkrZPXT4Xt
🔗 X: https://x.com/TG_Indie
